description: This header file defines an interface for a vector (dynamic array) of strings, including initialization, cloning, adding, searching, removal, destruction, dumping, conversion, comparison, sorting, and utility functions.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Init
methods.description: Initializes a string vector data structure.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Clone
methods.description: Clones an existing string vector into a new one.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Add
methods.description: Adds a string to the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Add_IfNotExist
methods.description: Adds a string to the vector if it does not already exist.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Find
methods.description: Finds the index of a string in the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_RemoveByIndex
methods.description: Removes a string at a specified index.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Destroy
methods.description: Frees resources associated with the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Dump
methods.description: Prints or logs the contents of the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_ConvertToKeyValueVector
methods.description: Converts the string vector to a key-value vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_Compare
methods.description: Compares two string vectors for equality.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_ToSortedList
methods.description: Returns a sorted list (string) representation of the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_ToList
methods.description: Returns a list (string) representation of the vector.

methods.name: STR_VECTOR_RemoveUnusedEntries
methods.description: Removes entries in the vector that are deemed unused.
